name: Summer Rath
source:
Raised in a struggling single-parent family with several brothers, Summer knows all about self-sufficiency.

She says that guys need to prove themselves to her, and has gone so far as to fist-fight them!

Summer seems to enjoy it when she's treated like "one of the boys."

She definitely has a thing for olive oil.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
